state_path.description: Directory for Magnum state and temporary files.

bind_host.description: IP address the API server listens on.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the API service.

enable_ssl_api.description: Enable HTTPS for the Magnum API endpoints.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required when enable_ssl_api=true).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required when enable_ssl_api=true).

keystone_region_name.description: Region name used by Magnum to discover services in Keystone.

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for Magnum service user.

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name for Magnum service user.

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for Magnum service user.

keystone_service_user.description: Username for the Magnum service user in Keystone.

keystone_service_password.description: Password for the Magnum service user in Keystone.

trust_enabled.description: Enable trust mechanism for cluster operations (required for cluster scaling, etc.).

trustee_domain_id.description: Domain ID for the trustee (if using delegated trust).

trustee_domain_admin.description: Username of the trustee domain admin (used when trustee_domain_id is set).

trustee_domain_admin_password.description: Password of the trustee domain admin (used when trustee_domain_id is set).

default_docker_volume_size.description: Default size (GiB) of the Docker volume attached to nodes.

default_node_count.description: Default number of worker nodes for newly created clusters.

enabled_cluster_templates.description: List of cluster template types enabled in this deployment.

items.description: Name of an enabled container orchestrator.

default_cluster_template.description: Default cluster template used when none is specified during cluster creation.

cluster_create_timeout.description: Timeout (minutes) for cluster creation before it is considered failed.

ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate used to sign cluster certificates (used with 'local' cert_manager).

ca_key.description: Path to CA private key used to sign cluster certificates (used with 'local' cert_manager).

pki_enabled.description: Enable PKI-based certificate generation (deprecated in favor of keystone/barbican).

pki_file_path.description: Base directory for PKI certificate storage (used when pki_enabled=true).

conductor_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the Conductor service.

max_cluster_nodes.description: Maximum number of nodes allowed per cluster.

k8s_enable_hpa.description: Enable Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler by default.

k8s_enable_dns.description: Enable Kubernetes DNS add-on in clusters.

k8s_insecure_registries.description: List of insecure (HTTP) Docker registries allowed in cluster nodes.

items.description: CIDR or IP address range for an insecure registry.

k8s_registry_mirror.description: Registry mirror URL to accelerate image pulls (e.g., 'https://mirror.gcr.io').

k8s_docker_storage_driver.description: Docker storage driver used in Kubernetes cluster nodes.
